source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, General Information and Lubrication, p.0-5

procedures.title: Push starting: manual transmission
steps: Switch off electrical loads such as heater, radio and, if you can, lights.
Press the clutch pedal down and put the shifter in high gear.
Let the clutch out once the car reaches 10 to 15 miles per hour.

procedures.title: Towing
steps: Tow on the rear wheels with the selector in N (Neutral), at 35 mph or less.
Disconnect the drive shaft, or tow on the front wheels instead, if: speed must exceed 35 MPH, the tow will be longer than 50 miles, or the transmission is not working properly.
When towing on the front wheels, lock the steering wheel in the straight-ahead position.
